{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Too many Americans struggle to afford prescription drugs they need to get or stay healthy.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"No American should find themselves foregoing or rationing medications because they can't afford to pay, especially when taxpayer money underwrites research leading to the development of many prescription drugs.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will take aggressive action to ensure that Americans do not pay more for prescription drugs than people in other advanced economies.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will ensure that all necessary medications are covered.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will empower Medicare to negotiate prescription drug prices for all public and private purchasers—for families and businesses, as well as older Americans—no matter where they get their coverage.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will prevent the price of brand-name and outlier generic drugs from rising faster than the inflation rate.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will cap out-of-pocket drug costs for seniors.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will ensure that effective treatments for chronic health conditions are available at little or no cost.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Prescription drug companies have gamed the system to justify their price increases by any means available.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will crack down on anti-competitive efforts to manipulate the patent system or collude on prices.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will eliminate tax breaks for prescription drug advertisements.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
